selection_rule: PubChem CIDs 1000 * k + 125 for k = 1..120, ascending, admitting the first 40 rows that pass the filter
admission_filter: PubChem returns both SMILES and a non-empty IUPACName
canonical SMILES not already in corpus.json or heldout.json or heldout2.json or heldout3.json or heldout4.json
inspection_policy: evaluation only: selected before any naming round 8 diagnosis, never inspected row by row, loaded only by naming_stage_artifact.py --final-evaluation
status_note: Scored once, at naming round 8's final evaluation (r8-final.json: 11 verbatim, 29 more equivalent, ZERO wrong structures; its per-row records are in the sealed sidecar stages/sealed/r8-final.heldout_v5.records.json). From round 9 on its rows may be read, adjudicated and fixed, so it measures fitting, not generalisation, and is reported as a tuning population beside v1 to v4. The population registry (populations.toml) records the same status; the fresh population for round 9 is v6.
